Hi Lindsey,

Thanks again for agreeing to be an Optima Ambassador — we really appreciate the time you spent on the case study call last week. As discussed, we'd like to send a small recognition package and a $500 platform credit, and we can also make a matched donation to a charity of your choice.

Quick checklist so we can finalize logistics:
- Confirm shipping address for the swag package (can be a home or office address)
- Confirm billing contact and whether Optima needs an invoice for internal tracking
- If you'd like the donation routed to a 501(c)(3), please confirm the charity name and whether you need a donation receipt emailed to procurement

I’ve attached a draft invoice and the current swag catalog for your selection. If everything looks good we’ll schedule shipment for next week.

Attachments:
- swag_pack_catalog_v2.pdf (PDF)
- invoice_OP-4821_ambassador.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — I’ll pause shipments until I hear from you.

Best,

Laura / Rishi — forwarding Optima’s response. Procurement wants a donation receipt and may need a PO for the combined $500 credit + swag. Can we confirm:

- We can issue a $500 account credit tied to deal OP-4821 (no invoiced amount required on Redwood side), and provide a PDF donation receipt for "Community Health Foundation" for $500 dated 2026-11-30.
- For swag, the fulfillment partner will produce a packing slip and we can generate an invoice stub for procurement if they need a PO.

Would appreciate confirmation to reply to Lindsey and procurement. If procurement requires a vendor invoice instead of a credit, we can issue an invoice for $0.00 with line items showing the credit and the swag value per their process (let me know which path is preferred).

Attaching the proposed donation receipt template for your review.

Hi all — thanks for the clear notes. Confirming the following so procurement can close their internal loop: 

1) Redwood will issue a $500 platform credit against OP-4821 effective today (no cash movement). That will appear on Optima’s billing ledger and can be referenced for reconciliation.
2) Redwood will generate a formal donation receipt for Community Health Foundation for $500, dated 2026-11-30. Attachment included.
3) Swag shipment will be sent to the SF address Lindsey provided. Fulfillment partner will include a packing slip. If procurement needs a PO for the physical goods, Optima can issue one; otherwise we’ll mark the shipment as \"promotion/gift\" and include the packing slip value for their records.

Next steps for Marcus: please confirm the chosen swag package SKU from the attached catalog and we’ll finalize the shipment day (aiming for 2026-12-08). Procurement — if you prefer a vendor invoice rather than a credit note, please confirm and we’ll produce the invoice/PO mapping.

Attachments:
- donation_receipt_OPTIMA_20261130.pdf (PDF, signed)
- swag_pack_catalog_v2.pdf (PDF)
